item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 14/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the northeast monsoon moderating, it will be warm over the coast of Guangdong during the day tomorrow. A replenishment of the monsoon will affect southern China on Friday and Saturday. Under the influence of a warm and humid maritime airstream, it will be foggy over the coast of Guangdong early next week. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Temperatures will fall over the region.
